summary:
Executed docs/slice-testing-strategy.md for slice 006. All 19 verification.json criteria checked with a verdict + evidence each: 16 verified — largely by re-running the Charts repo's own gates myself (tests/render-consumer.sh, tests/publish.sh, helm lint, plus a re-read of the already-green kaniko `--no-push` build log) rather than trusting the established GREEN sweep alone, and by read-only live probes (`resolve-helm-args`, `deploy config`/`deploy template` against HelmCharts, DNS lookup, registry:5000 tag probe). No idempotence/check-mode/blast-radius/cluster-serial concerns apply — the slice's only Ansible-repo change is `.kubecoder/config.yaml` + workspace file registering new repos, no ansible/terraform content touched. No product defect found; nothing clears the generation bar.

Pushed on this pass: `Charts` (pre-authorized dev-tier push). `Ansible` too, after the push-nudge caught it: local main had diverged from origin (unrelated concurrent history landed on origin/main while this slice worked, last common ancestor a8506f5), so `dev:rebase-agent` rebased the slice's one commit (`7db7610` 'Added new repos.', touching only `.kubecoder/config.yaml` + workspace file) onto origin/main — zero conflicts, disjoint files, gate (`kc project lint/build/test`, full sweep) green afterwards — and I pushed the result (`fb0aae8`). The CI build the doc names, `IaC/Build-Main` #131, ran against that exact commit and is SUCCESS.

Deliberately NOT pushed: HelmCharts (`053ddab`, 'P3: charts.home as an ordinary HelmCharts release'). This is the operator's keystroke by this slice's own explicit, deliberated ruling (plan.md: 'who pushes the HelmCharts half' — 'the test phase pushes Charts but MUST NOT push HelmCharts... This keeps the first deploy of a new namespace, and the Terraform apply behind it, on the operator's keystroke, per this repo's doctrine'), matches this dispatch's own boundary ('prd stays operator-gated; nothing here touches it' — a push to HelmCharts main deploys straight to prd via `githubPush()` -> TF infra apply -> `helm upgrade --install` -> TF config apply, not a dev-tier action), and is itself verification criterion V18. Unlike Ansible, this is not a divergence/rebase problem — the push is a clean fast-forward, held back by policy, not by git state. This is exactly the 'second keystroke' the plan's ordering constraints predicted would surface as a driver unpushed-bail ('Both are expected, neither is an error'): the anticipated resolution is the operator pushing HelmCharts and the run resuming, not this session pushing it.

V12/V13/V14 (live DNS+TLS, end-to-end Helm-client resolution against charts.home) are correctly OWED, not verified: the `IaC/Charts` Jenkins job does not exist yet (confirmed via the Jenkins API — no job at that path), so even though Charts is now on origin, nothing has built or published `registry:5000/charts-home` yet (confirmed 404 on both the registry and `resolve-helm-args`), and `charts.home` does not resolve (NXDOMAIN). This is the expected pre-deploy state the plan itself anticipated, not a slice defect.

Operator steps owed, in order (the ordering matters — image before deploy):
1. Create the Jenkins job `IaC/Charts`: Pipeline script from SCM, repo `https://github.com/pvginkel/Charts.git`, branch `*/main`, credentials `5f6fbd66-b41c-405f-b107-85ba6fd97f10`, script path `Jenkinsfile`. Then run it once by hand (Build Now) — `Charts` is already on origin/main, so this build packages+indexes dist/, pushes `registry:5000/charts-home:1` and `:latest`, and (via `cicd.helmDeploy()`) triggers a HelmCharts deploy — harmless at this point since HelmCharts main does not yet carry the `charts` release.
2. Once that build is green and the image exists: `cd /work/HelmCharts && git push origin main` — deploys commit 053ddab, which creates namespace `charts-prd` (TF infra apply), installs the `charts` release (image now resolves), and applies TF config. This is the prd-mutating step and stays operator-gated regardless of the devlock, per the plan's explicit ruling.

After both land, V12/V13/V14 can be settled by: `curl -sk https://charts.home/index.yaml` (or `helm repo add homelab https://charts.home && helm repo update && helm search repo homelab/homelab-shared`) and a DNS lookup for both `charts.home` and `charts`.
cards: Pre-existing, unrelated to this slice: `poetry run resolve-helm-args .` (repo-root/JSON mode) crashes with an uncaught RuntimeError instead of degrading gracefully when `helm`/cluster access fails for an unrelated release (hit this for trello-mcp-prd, version-poller-prd, webathome-org-prd, zigbee2mqtt-prd — this pod's read-only kubeconfig can't list Secrets in those namespaces). `process_release()` only catches `ImageResolutionError`, not this class of failure. Did not affect verification of the `prd/charts` release specifically (probed with the single-release invocation instead), and `resolve_helm_args.py` is untouched by this slice's diff.
